conclusion: The INLONG and _Infinity3DP vendor manifests declare nine common process templates. Their shipped external bridge defaults remain bridge_flow = 1.05 and bridge_density = 105%, while organic tree support branch diameter is tree_support_branch_diameter_organic = 3.0 mm. All 46 declared processes and the default print profiles of all 63 selectable machine/nozzle presets resolve that organic diameter. Update these shared process templates rather than duplicating defaults into each selectable process or adding process-only options to machine profiles. Existing saved project and user preset overrides retain their own values. Internal bridge settings remain unchanged.
scope: INLONG and Infinity3DP shipped process profiles

verification.method: Exact byte and one-key semantic comparison; complete manifest-driven process and machine-default inheritance audit; existing profile regression tests
verification.summary: Nine common templates changed only tree_support_branch_diameter_organic from 2 to 3.0, preserving file encoding and line endings. All 46 declared process profiles and all 63 selectable machine/nozzle default process links resolve 3.0. Eleven existing profile tests passed, including external and internal bridge defaults and compatibility contracts. Ten pre-existing uncommitted files retained their hashes. Source commit fields are checkout anchors and do not claim the changed profile bytes were committed.
